description_expanded: OverviewHot TubGulf Place Condo - Private Beach-1 Minute Walk - Seasonally Heated Community PoolThe Space Gulf Place Caribbean – Cozy Beach Getaway with Pool & Hot Tub! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Quick Walk to the Beach – Just steps to the Gulf’s sugar-white sands Community Pool & Hot Tub – Relax & unwind in a resort-style setting 1 Bedroom + Bunks – Sleeps up to 6 guests comfortably Private Balcony – Enjoy Gulf breezes & scenic views Fully Equipped Kitchen – Everything you need for easy home-cooked meals Located in the Heart of Gulf Place – Walk to shops, restaurants & entertainment General Parking On-Site – Hassle-free & convenient Wi-Fi Included – Stay connected while you unwind Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free vacationWelcome to Caribbean 107A jewel in sought-after Gulf Place Caribbean on Highway 30A! Quaint 1 bedroom with bunks that affords to sleep 6 people is the perfect beach getaway. This charming condo has been beautifully maintained and updated with a decorating scheme that has fun at the beach in mind! Sit back on your balcony and soak in the sun and enjoy the Gulf breezes with the Gulf of Mexico located right across the street. This condo conveys with a seasoned rental history - Enjoy the many amenities of Gulf Place including: 3 pools, hot tubs, deeded beach access and tennis courts, while being just steps to the Gulf Place shops, artists' colony, restaurants and outdoor festivals the area is famous for!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**** There is ongoing construction in this community. Scaffolding will be present on building exterior**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (4):Bedroom - King sized bedCommon Area - Twin over twin bunk bedsAREA ATTRACTIONS:Gulf Place, just opposite Ed Walline beach access and located just steps from the famous sugar-white sand and turquoise waters of Northwest Florida’s celebrated Emerald Coast, Gulf Place is one of 30A’s original urban developments. The 25-acre community is located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach on the corner of 30A and 393. Gulf Place was specifically designed to offer a one stop vacation destination with beautiful palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, outdoor patios with large umbrellas, a nature walking trail, plentiful green space, tennis, pools and more.Gulf Place offers amenities for all including a coffee shop, 2 ice cream/candy shops, Arcade for the kids, Yolo bike & board rentals, Shunk Gulley wine and spirits store, boutiques, gift shops, 30A store and more! There are casual to upscale dining options steps from our condo or a short walk to: Chef’s 30A Deli, The Perfect Pig, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar, Shelby’s Beach Bar & Grill, Cava & Cakes, The Vue on 30A, South of Philly, Goatfeathers, Pizza by the sea, Basmati’s, Local Catch and Growler Garage. Also Awakening Wellness Spa and 2 excellent nail salons. Gulf Place host a fun wine walk each month spotlighting local merchants, delicious food and of course wine. Just a short bike ride away you can enjoy the Blue Mountain area and all its restaurant and retail offerings as well as the Dune Allen area and Topsail preserve state park. There’s lots of shopping in the Gulf Place area and a short walk east you can enjoy Lola’s and the Justin Gaffrey Art Gallery.Show less
